title: NPE in HttpObjectAggregator
body:
In some cases `HttpObjectAggregator` throws NPE (trace below). It's always happens in combination with `channelInactive`.

```
java.lang.NullPointerException: null
    at io.netty.handler.codec.http.HttpObjectAggregator.decode(HttpObjectAggregator.java:172) ~[netty-codec-http-4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT.jar:4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT]

Wrapped by: io.netty.handler.codec.DecoderException: java.lang.NullPointerException

    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelHandlerContext.fireChannelRead(DefaultChannelHandlerContext.java:324) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT.jar:4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT]
    at io.netty.handler.codec.ReplayingDecoder.channelInactive(ReplayingDecoder.java:345) [netty-codec-4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT.jar:4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT]
    at io.netty.handler.codec.http.HttpClientCodec$Decoder.channelInactive(HttpClientCodec.java:212) [netty-codec-http-4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT.jar:4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT]
```

Trace above when using 4.0.15 (0b8e732c6cce5bade1cf5d8a8d87e5c788c6d20f), but it's also happens with 4.0.14
